== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Lone Pilot, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 11 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of January 1, 2013” (PDF made 16 April 2013): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf source], preserved copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Lone Pilot (PC Errata 2013 slip)]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/0e/Premiere-D-lonepilot-PC-Errata-2013-slip.png Internet Archive item].
